1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits a specific enolate reactivity distinct from corresponding potassium salts__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl or ethyl and the sodium salt exhibits enhanced selectivity in nucleophilic addition reactions compared to potassium analogs__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl, __wherein the sodium enolate of the β-keto methyl ester exhibits different reactivity characteristics than the corresponding potassium enolate of the β-keto ethyl ester__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein the compound is specifically the sodium salt and exhibits distinct enolate reactivity properties__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium enolate exhibits enhanced regioselectivity or chemoselectivity in organic synthesis compared to other alkali metal analogs__.
